venue_notes: Planning details only; vendor bookings, confirmations, quotes and commitments are not available. The €0 total is confirmed spend recorded here, not an all-in forecast. Confirm the schedule, guest count, setup needs and contingencies with the quinta, caterer, photographer and DJ. Tell guests the last shuttle to the hotel leaves at 01:30.

If the forecast is over 32°C, move cocktails from the olive grove to the wine cellar; confirm the move arrangements with the quinta.
If the ceremony starts late, shorten cocktails rather than the ceremony, and update the venue, caterer, photographer and DJ on timing changes.
Tell the quinta Pimienta will attend as ring bearer and confirm any arrangements needed for the dog.
If cuts are needed, cut fireworks before the interpreter; preserve the interpreter within the €42,000 cap.
